items.statement: The investigation retains candidate identity/atom mapping and validates optimized minima with a stationary-point test, reporting imaginary modes and failed candidates.
items.expected: A reproducible candidate-by-candidate validation table exists; minima are distinguished from unvalidated structures.

items.statement: The reported OH modes are assigned to the explicitly defined experimental bands and compared using their mode identity rather than unlabeled peak matching.
items.expected: Band labels, computed frequencies and mode identities are reported for the compared clusters.

items.statement: Within the paper's explicitly selected A-series, the structural evidence identifies a hydration-driven change in BaOH···water organization between n=2 and n=3; competing B-series candidates remain part of the uncertainty boundary.
items.expected: The report distinguishes the A-series n=1–2 and n=3–5 distance/topology classes, retains 4B/5B competing candidates and does not claim that the n=3 onset is a global lowest-energy result.

items.statement: The hydrogen-bond-sensitive OH feature undergoes a marked red-shift from n=1–2 to n=3 and splitting at larger n.
items.expected: The report captures the n-dependent spectral evolution and compares it with the supplied bands.
